process.selectRequired: Select a process from the list.
profile.title: Backup profile
profile.name: Name
profile.backupFolderTip: Root folder where archives for this profile are stored. A subfolder named after the profile (slug) is created inside it, and archives are named name_date_time.7z|.zip.
profile.retentionTip: How many recent archives to keep for this profile. After a successful backup, older files are deleted. For example, with 10 only the 10 newest archives are kept.
profile.checksumTip: Before backup, SHA-256 is computed for all source files. If the file set and checksums match the last successful backup, no new archive is created. Useful for schedules and in-app auto-backup.
profile.watchProcess: Backup only while the program is running
profile.watchProcessTip: If enabled and a process is set below, backups run only while that program is running. After it exits, one farewell backup is made, then waiting for the next launch.
profile.processExeTip: Exe name (game.exe), full path, or a mask with * (e.g. *elden* or C:\Games\*\game.exe). Pick from running processes or browse for a file.
profile.processScanSecTip: How often to check whether the watched process is running (for highlight and in-app schedule). Default 10. Lower values react faster but use more CPU.
profile.launchTip: A command to start a game or program: an exe path, a command line, or a Steam game (Steam… button). When set, the profile list shows its icon on the left and a launch button on the right. The button turns gray while that program is already running.
profile.steamEmpty: Steam was not found, or there are no installed games.
profile.steamSelectRequired: Select a game from the list.
profile.inAppScheduleTip: If Task Scheduler is off, the app will back up on the given interval (minutes) while BackupSaves is open (including tray). Auto-backup stops when the app exits.
profile.sourcesHint: Files and folders to back up
profile.editPathHint: You can type a path manually, including %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA%, %USERPROFILE%, %DOCUMENTS%.
profile.errWatchProcess: Enter an exe name, path, or process mask to watch.
profile.errProcessScanSec: Process scan interval must be ≥ 1 second.
